metrics.name: Extensibility

metrics.name: Dependencies

findings.root_cause: Unicode whitespace byte offset advanced by one byte; unchecked public integer/count arithmetic
findings.consequence: Valid Unicode text panics in NER; mismatched foreshadowing input and extreme year also panic in debug

findings.root_cause: Completeness inferred only from unmatched unassessed findings, not omitted candidate population
findings.consequence: --new-only exits 0 with one new warning omitted by maxFindings=1

findings.root_cause: Correction materialization replays original history; cluster joins require any matching alias without a cluster exclusion invariant
findings.consequence: Reject resurrected as Alice; John Smith/Smith/Mary Smith collapse

findings.root_cause: Unordered extraction passes and duplicated live/history state lose grammatical roles, event order and acquisition provenance
findings.consequence: Reversed communication, impossible-knowledge false proof, concurrent contradictory current locations

findings.root_cause: Divergent segmentation and coordinate systems; repeated silent-e correction; lowercased positions reused on originals; SARIF lacks BOM transform
findings.consequence: Wrong syllables/sentences, LF/CRLF variance changes, corrupted mention quotations, SARIF offsets +1 with BOM

findings.root_cause: No total tie ordering; inconsistent score units/populations and pacing direction
findings.consequence: 24 voice calls yielded 24 top-word arrays; nonlinear health 1 instead of percent-scale 100; causal coherence 4 for five events; conflicting pacing advice

findings.root_cause: Rich legacy schemas retained after removal or without implementation; unsupported semantic cases assigned neutral/positive values
findings.consequence: Reserved analysis looks successful; genre health stands in for unmeasured conventions; reader advantage structurally degenerate

findings.root_cause: Promise creation has no general fulfillment pass; resolved boolean lacks payoff location
findings.consequence: Answered explicit question marked broken; caller-resolved foreshadowing assigned invented final-scene payoff

findings.root_cause: Process-global raw-text cache has no bound, eviction or clear
findings.consequence: Distinct NER windows/revisions remain in memory for process lifetime, even with unavailable model

findings.root_cause: Ambient model discovery and global first-use initialization; positional model profiles
findings.consequence: CWD may select unintended model; first failure permanent; valid class count does not establish label semantics

findings.evidence_kind: Fresh automated checks and authoritative upstream reports
findings.root_cause: Policy configured but not executed in CI; optional dependency pin excludes upstream safety fixes
findings.consequence: RUSTSEC-2026-0383 in webpki-root-certs1.0.9 via ort-sys build; tokio1.53.1 unsound advisory; ort rc15 reports safety fixes beyond pinned rc13; exploit reachability not established

findings.root_cause: Build jobs substitute for packed-artifact runtime/install verification
findings.consequence: Claimed Windows/macOS/Linux target installation and active-LTS compatibility remain unproved

findings.evidence_kind: Fresh regression tests and retained evaluation evidence
findings.root_cause: Agent-authored small templated corpus and narrow facade rules; no independent editorial or trained-model semantic evaluation
findings.consequence: 14 held-out matched findings/0 rated FP-FN plus4 unrated do not establish real-manuscript accuracy; removing controls yields10 rated FP

findings.evidence_kind: Source complexity inference plus retained benchmarks
findings.root_cause: Dense cooccurrence/SVD, full dictionary suggestion scans, cumulative snapshot copies, lexical index not refreshed on document update
findings.consequence: 50MB base cooccurrence at2500 words before workspaces; possible quadratic growing snapshots; stale lexical retrieval; actual scaling/hotspot share unmeasured

findings.root_cause: Handwritten NAPI ts_return_type overrides duplicate serde contracts without runtime validation for standalone enums
findings.consequence: WorldFact uses characterAt while types require CharacterAt; payoff status broken/outstanding while declarations require Broken/Outstanding; TS compilation alone does not catch mismatch

roadmap.proposed: Checked Unicode windows and defined count/year input contracts
roadmap.acceptance: No panic on four Unicode whitespace reproductions; empty/mismatched scene counts and year extrema have defined validated outcomes; fuzz all affected entry points
Existing reproduction exits2 or proves all introduced findings within declared exhaustive coverage; test omitted limit-1/limit/limit+1 including all retained findings persistent

roadmap.current_behavior: Historical corrections replay and greedy alias bridge
roadmap.proposed: Collapse corrections once; preserve per-surface counts; enforce full-name exclusion/ambiguity
roadmap.expected_benefit: Honor author authority and character identity
roadmap.acceptance: Latest Assign/Reject wins for present/absent surfaces; history idempotent; all name permutations preserve incompatible people

roadmap.current_behavior: Advisory-bearing lock and no policy gate
roadmap.proposed: Patch webpki roots/Tokio; assess pinned ort rc15 migration; run locked policy in CI
roadmap.expected_benefit: Close known dependency exposure and prevent recurrence
roadmap.acceptance: cargo audit/deny clean for supported graph or documented reachability-based exception; native fixtures and feature/MSRV gates pass; controlled rejected dependency fails pipeline

roadmap.current_behavior: Divergent original-text, segmentation and readability primitives
roadmap.proposed: Canonical spans/coordinate adapters and validated formula resources
roadmap.expected_benefit: Repair evidence and measurements across analyzers
roadmap.acceptance: Canonical count equals spans; five syllable golden words correct; LF/CRLF metrics equivalent; every mention slices original; SARIF text offsets invariant to BOM while facade offsets preserve raw input

roadmap.proposed: One ordered provenance-bearing event reducer; adapt or deprecate unsupported legacy proof modes
roadmap.expected_benefit: Fix direction, state invalidation and knowledge reasoning together
roadmap.acceptance: Cast permutations invariant; one live location/owner; co-location follows current locations; releases remove locks; explicit discovery never impossible knowledge; chronology barriers preserved

roadmap.proposed: Uniform available/unsupported/unknown statuses and evidence provenance
roadmap.acceptance: Subtext/thematic/mental stubs report unavailable; unsupported genre conventions unknown; no model-less positive verdict; README and machine catalog match implementations

roadmap.current_behavior: Immortal cache and ambient first-use model
roadmap.proposed: Caller-owned bounded clearable cache and explicit model locations/profiles
roadmap.expected_benefit: Bound retention and make model identity reproducible
roadmap.acceptance: Distinct-revision retention <=declared budget; clear releases text; CWD cannot activate model by default; invalid explicit model does not select fallback; digest/profile recorded

roadmap.proposed: Total ordering before truncation, explicit score units and shared metric direction
roadmap.acceptance: 100 fresh-process canonical outputs identical including ties; nonlinear example healthPct100; causal example coherence in[0,1]; pacing guidance agrees at boundaries

roadmap.proposed: Staged package install/runtime tests on all declared targets and supported Node lines
roadmap.acceptance: Fresh packed root+platform installs pass CJS/ESM/types/manuscript smoke on four declared targets; declared Node floor/currentLTS pass; publication bound to successful tested commit/artifact

roadmap.proposed: Independent editorial corpus plus real model reference comparisons
roadmap.expected_benefit: Establish real accuracy, utility and calibration evidence
roadmap.acceptance: Freeze external held-out texts; annotate double-blind/disjoint by work and template; report rule/span FP-FN, abstention, controls ablation, Brier/reliability, model labels/truncation, native/WASM tolerances; preregister release targets

roadmap.current_behavior: Known scan/dense/index mechanisms without scaling attribution
roadmap.proposed: Atomic lexical+dense updates; profile spelling and sparse/truncated alternatives
roadmap.expected_benefit: Correct edited retrieval and reduce measured hot-path cost
roadmap.acceptance: Inserted rare term retrievable/deleted term absent after update; same-profile release benchmarks and scaling recorded; choose optimization only for measured gain with no contract regression

roadmap.current_behavior: Boolean resolution and unsupported broken-promise claims
roadmap.proposed: Typed author-confirmed setup/payoff/transfer/knowledge events with exact scene/evidence
roadmap.expected_benefit: Useful verifiable narrative constraints without invented understanding
roadmap.acceptance: Explicit answered-question fixture fulfilled at actual scene; unknown links abstain; no fabricated payoff locations; edit/reorder comparison preserves identities

roadmap.proposed: Entity-aware candidate retrieval plus calibrated optional local NLI/mention ranking; keep author facts authoritative
roadmap.expected_benefit: Test semantic assistance beyond explicit patterns
roadmap.acceptance: Pre-registered comparison against rules/author-event and BookNLP-style baselines at equal workloads; improve useful recall at fixed FP/latency/memory budgets or reject mechanism

roadmap.risk: Medium; consumers may depend on current wire shapes
roadmap.current_behavior: Handwritten standalone TS shapes drift from serde JSON
roadmap.proposed: Derive standalone wire declarations/schemas from existing Rust serde types using current bindings machinery; preserve or version actual wire representations
roadmap.expected_benefit: Make typed integrations executable and prevent enum drift
roadmap.acceptance: Each public standalone enum variant/struct shape validates against generated schema; CJS/ESM typed consumer smoke reads real CharacterAt/PayoffStatus data without unchecked casts; existing facade contract checks remain valid

package_inventory.limit: Inventory only; not a fresh installed package or release build
